Vary your looks to Ketel Marte and Corbin Carroll: avoid predictable fastballs to Marte and change speeds below the zone to Carroll. Use breaking balls against Nolan Arenado and Gabriel Moreno. Tanner Scott is the closer, with Blake Treinen and Will Klein leading setup. Alex Vesia and Jack Dreyer are limited after pitching yesterday; reserve them for a necessary matchup.
reminders: Lean on sweepers and splitters to change speeds.
Use Treinen and Klein to reach Scott in a close late game.
Save limited lefties for when needed.
